title: The Blindness of the Walking Dead — Part 2

series.summary: With outside help an impossibility, genius student Saya Takagi breaks down the terrifying science of the outbreak. Comparing it to the historical Black Death and Spanish Flu, she points out a grim deviation: unlike regular disease victims, these corpses reanimate and relentlessly hunt the living. Dismissing hopes that summer heat will decompose the bodies, Saya warns they will walk indefinitely. Takashi convinces the group to unite and escape toward the parking lot to find their families. Inspecting the hallway, Saya deduces a critical secret: the monsters cannot see and react purely to sound.

segments.voiceover_text: Saya compares the outbreak to the medieval plague, but notes the terrifying difference: ordinary victims stay dead, but these corpses rise and hunt the living.
Kohta hopes summer heat will decompose the bodies. Saya crushes that fragile hope: these creatures show no decay and will continue hunting indefinitely.
Takashi rallies the survivors to unite as one team. To find their families, they must break through the infested building and secure a getaway vehicle.
Observing the hallway, Saya reveals a critical weakness: the dead are blind and track prey purely by sound. But who will risk their life to test the theory?
